disposition_reason: Tables 1 to 3 print per-sample cadmium, lead and copper (mean ± SD of five replicates) by stripping voltammetry and by AAS for 26 honeys and 4 edible molasses samples.

study.design: Analytical method study applied to collected honey and market molasses
study.origin: honey from 12 localities of Assiut governorate, Egypt (clover, multi-flower, citrus)
study.market: edible molasses from the Egyptian market
study.method: HNO3 then HNO3/HClO4 wet digestion; differential pulse anodic stripping voltammetry (HMDE, Britton-Robinson buffer pH 2.1, standard addition); GFAAS for Cd and Pb, flame AAS for Cu
study.qa: Five replicates per sample; agreement between DPASV and AAS; no CRM or recovery reported
